settings.title: Conscious Evolution Denver 2024: Unlock Your Evolutionary Potential
settings.text:
GREGG BRADEN AND BRUCE H. LIPTON, PHD TEAM UP IN DENVER FOR A SPECIAL RARE 2-DAY WORKSHOP.

Are you ready to unlock your evolutionary potential and join a movement of conscious change-makers? The Conscious Evolution Denver 2024 event is your opportunity to do just that guided by Bruce Lipton and Gregg Braden. Bruce Lipton’s ground-breaking research in cell biology has shaken the world of biology; coupled with Gregg Braden’s exploration of ancient wisdom and modern science and most importantly their close friendship, this event will help you better understand and change the interconnectedness between you and your world.

This transformative 2-day gathering will help you understand fractal geometry, quantum physics, epigenetics, and neuroscience, unlocking how your thoughts, attitudes, and beliefs shape your reality.

settings.title: Bruce H. Lipton PH.D
settings.text:
THE SCIENCE OF PERSONAL AND GLOBAL TRANSFORMATION

THRIVING IN A WORLD OF CHANGE

Civilization is in a world of crises. Crisis ignites evolution! From an evolutionary standpoint, we are surrounded by evidence that we are on the threshold of an extraordinary evolutionary event, the dawn of a new civilization – Conscious Evolution.

NASA scientists report that current civilization is facing an irreversible collapse within the next twenty years. The problem responsible for today’s planetary chaos is that to sustain itself, civilization requires 1.6 planet Earth’s to provide society’s needed resources.

Considering there is not an extra .6 Earth, civilization is imminently facing an unsustainable future. The good news in the bad news is that a renaissance in frontier science provides knowledge of how we can safely navigate this dark passage and thrive into a healthier sustainable future.

In a dynamic and paradigm-shifting multimedia presentation designed for the lay audience, cell biologist and bestselling author Bruce H. Lipton, Ph.D., offers a synthesis of fractal geometry, quantum physics, epigenetics, and neuroscience that illuminates the mechanisms by which our thoughts, attitudes, and beliefs create the character of our lives and our place in the world.

Knowledge is power. The new knowledge of “self” offered in this programme is the source of self-empowerment needed to thrive through this turbulent period in our planet’s history. Awakening to our inherent power will enable participants to reclaim creative control over their lives and contribute to the planet’s higher evolutionary destiny. A miraculous healing awaits this planet once we accept our new responsibility to tend the Garden rather than fight over the turf collectively.

settings.title: Gregg Braden
settings.text:
BECOMING THE NEW HUMAN - FROM EVOLUTION BY CHANCE TO TRANSFORMATION BY CHOICE

The science is clear: We are not what we’ve been told, and even more than we’ve imagined!

It’s no secret that we’re living in a time of extremes. From broken economies and global conflict to social change and climate change, the events of our lives are pushing us into uncharted levels of change, uncertainty and stress. Within each of us lie dormant abilities and extraordinary potentials to embrace these changes, and more, far beyond what was believed to be possible in the past.

Diverse fields of study, ranging from human evolution and genetics to the emerging science of neuro-cardiology and heart intelligence, have revealed new discoveries, and a new human story of self-empowerment and extraordinary potential.

Join five-time New York Times bestselling author and 2020 Temple Award nominee Gregg Braden on this multi-sensory journey to discover the power of the new human story in your life! In this highly visual and deeply experiential presentation, Gregg crosses the traditional boundaries between modern science, ancient wisdom and timeless spirituality to reveal the deep truth of human origins, the literal message coded into our DNA, and 3 proven techniques that awaken our divine human potentials of self-regulation that include:

  • Igniting your super immune system On-Demand!
  • Accessing advanced states of deep-intuition On-Demand!
  • Awakening advanced states of longevity On-Demand!

Awakening advanced states of bio-plasticity, neuroplasticity and genetic plasticity for health, healing, rejuvenation and regeneration!

When the evidence no longer supports the story, it’s time for a new story. It’s this simple fact that lies at the core of this programme: Becoming the New Human.

settings.title: World's Biggest Labyrinth
settings.dropdown_text:
On one of the days we’ll explore La Senda, the world’s biggest labyrinth. It is located in the middle of the dry tropical forest of Guanacaste, and offers you a perfect gateway to another realm.

The labyrinth measures above 2.5 acres (over 1 hectare) and the path is almost 2 miles (3km) long. It took 6 years to develop and now is fully planted with over 5.000 cactus. All sentient beings, like humans, animals, and plants in La Senda constantly live under the upbeat influence of this big pulsing heart of energy.

settings.title: Cancellation and Refunds
settings.dropdown_text:
If you choose to cancel your participation in this retreat, we will not refund any deposits or subsequent payments regardless of circumstances. Given this policy, we strongly suggest that you purchase travel insurance in case of emergencies or unforeseen circumstances that may arise at your end.

Travel insurance will protect your investment in case of unforeseen situations or emergencies. If you choose to purchase travel insurance, which we highly recommend, you must do so on your own. We have been working with Travel Guard International at 800 826-1300, and have received positive feedback. When you purchase this insurance, please take some time to double check what is covered. Each state has slightly different policies. Be sure that you are getting coverage that includes a refund if the Host of the retreat is unavailable to attend if you wish to apply that option.

In the unlikely circumstances that Global Journeys Inc. is forced to cancel or postpone this retreat, we can apply your total amount you have paid towards a future retreat with Global Journeys within one year of the beginning date of this present retreat or you can receive a full refund.

If one of the presenters is not able to attend the event due to a serious illness or emergency, the other presenter will deliver the sessions and the retreat will go on as scheduled. If both presenters are unable to attend the event, they will either choose an appropriate substitute or deliver the program virtually if possible.

settings.title: Disclosure
settings.dropdown_text:
Global Journeys Inc. offers various travel opportunities to the general public. Global Journeys Inc., its owners and contracted personnel have taken what they believe to be reasonable precautions to create and conduct safe trips.

As a participant you must recognize that any trip may have inherent dangers including but not limited to your involvement in: flying in commercial airlines over U.S. land, other countries, and ocean waters; travel in vehicles on crowded streets and mountain highways; swimming in swimming pools with no lifeguards, eating and drinking food that may be foreign and different to what you are normally used to; exposure to intense sun and hot and humid conditions; and being exposed to other unpredictable situations that may be incurred in Coste Rica. If you choose to participate in yoga sessions be responsible and move at your own pace. You may choose to swim, note there is no lifeguard, so you are responsible for your swimming safety.

Your decision to participate in this retreat means that you are physically, mentally, and emotionally capable of safely handling this trip to Costa Rica. If you have any suspicion, no matter how slight, that you may have a physical or mental health condition, which may prevent you from participating on this trip safely, it is your responsibility to seek medical treatment or consultation to verify whether you should participate on this trip. Please do not go on this trip if you do not believe you have the appropriate skills or physical/emotional/mental capabilities to safely participate. We recommend highly that you have medical insurance and have your card on the trip, as well as purchase travel insurance for this trip.
